claims.quote: [![latest-release-badge](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/SinTan1729/chhoto-url?logo=github)](https://github.com/SinTan1729/chhoto-url/releases/latest)

claims.quote: A simple selfhosted URL shortener
claims.statement: The product is a self-hosted URL shortener — the core function of the category exists

within.statement: The tool contains a shortening function that accepts a submitted URL and returns a short link, with no restriction on the URL's length.

claims.tier_basis: If the product is not a working self-hosted URL shortener, the branded add-on the buyer plans to sell does not exist and there is nothing to close over. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a link shortener".

claims.quote: with no unnecessary features
claims.statement: The product carries no features beyond the ones necessary to its function — a boundary on its feature set
claims.tier_basis: Extra features beyond the necessary ones would not, on their own, change the price, the terms or the buyer's plan; the privacy threshold concerns what is recorded about visitors, not how many features the product carries, and this claim is rated on its own. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: The scratch docker image is <4.5 MB (compressed),

Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "memory, image-size or resource figures materially worse than stated, because at 900 instances the hosting cost is the margin".

Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "memory, image-size or resource figures materially worse than stated, because at 900 instances the hosting cost is the margin".

claims.quote: it uses <10 MB of RAM under regular use.

Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "memory, image-size or resource figures materially worse than stated, because at 900 instances the hosting cost is the margin".

within.statement: The maintainer regards the project as finished and maintained rather than abandoned

Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote:
I will also try to keep it updated in terms of

claims.quote:
I decided

claims.quote: Chhoto (ছোট, [pronunciation](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ছোট)) is the Bangla word for small. URL means, well... URL. So the name simply means Small URL.

claims.tier_basis: The etymology of the product's name touches nothing the buyer is paying for, no stated threshold and no item of the buyer's plan. If it were false, neither the price nor the terms would change. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: The database is cleared every 15 minutes
claims.statement: The seller's hosted demo instance clears its database every 15 minutes.

claims.quote: Shortens URLs of any length
claims.statement: The tool contains a shortening function that accepts a submitted URL and returns a short link, with no restriction on the URL's length.
claims.tier_basis: Accepting a submitted URL and returning a short link is the function the buyer is buying; its failure leaves no add-on to sell and repair means Rust nobody at the buyer reads. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a link shortener".

claims.quote: to a randomly generated link
claims.statement: The short links produced by the tool are randomly generated.
claims.tier_basis: The buyer's plan does not rest on the slugs being random: it names custom slugs as the feature it pays for, and random generation is marked on the practice's reading as something it uses without having said how much links per instance matter. If slugs were not random, nothing in the price or terms would change on its own. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: Automatic expiry of links after a chosen time.
claims.statement: The tool contains expiry logic that deactivates or removes links after a user-chosen time.
claims.tier_basis: Expiry is a documented feature the buyer named as a price mover if missing or partial, and the price was set from the documentation on the assumption it is accurate. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a documented feature (custom slugs, expiry, the command-line client, the API) that is missing or partial".

claims.quote: Allows you to specify the shortened URL instead of the generated one

claims.tier_basis: Custom slugs are a documented feature the buyer named as a price mover if missing or partial, and the price assumed the documentation is accurate. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a documented feature (custom slugs, expiry, the command-line client, the API) that is missing or partial".

claims.quote: Opening the shortened URL in your browser will instantly redirect you to the correct long URL.
claims.statement: The server contains a redirect handler that maps each short URL to its stored long URL and issues a redirect response.
claims.tier_basis: The redirect handler is the core of the add-on: every customer's visitors follow short links in emails, and without it there is no product to sell and no substitute the buyer's engineers could build around unread Rust. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "a link shortener".

claims.quote: The docker image is only ~6MB
claims.statement: The Docker image is approximately 6MB.

within.statement: The tool is available as a Docker container.

claims.tier_basis: At 900 instances the hosting cost is the margin, and the buyer named image-size figures as something that would change the price if materially worse than stated. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "memory, image-size or resource figures materially worse than stated, because at 900 instances the hosting cost is the margin".

claims.quote: RAM uasge stays under 5MB under normal use.

claims.tier_basis: The add-on is profitable at $4 a month only because one instance fits the buyer's 256 MB machines, and the buyer named memory figures as something that would change the price if materially worse than stated. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "memory, image-size or resource figures materially worse than stated, because at 900 instances the hosting cost is the margin".

claims.quote: Counts number of hits for each short link
claims.statement: The tool contains hit-counting code that keeps a per-link visit count.
claims.tier_basis: Hit counting is the one thing the buyer said the product records about visitors, and the buyer's European offering rests on it; a counter that does not exist leaves the buyer selling a counter that does not count, in code it cannot read. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "records nothing about the people who click a link beyond a count of hits, so the buyer can offer it to European customers without a new data-processing assessment".

claims.quote: only the hit is recorded, and nothing else
claims.statement: Only the hit count is recorded about each visit, and nothing else — no other data about the visitor or the visit is stored.
claims.tier_basis: This is a boundary claim: its failure admits stored or transmitted visitor data inside code the buyer cannot patch, which is what the buyer said would end the deal. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "records nothing about the people who click a link beyond a count of hits, so the buyer can offer it to European customers without a new data-processing assessment".

claims.quote: Short links can be edited after creation.
claims.statement: Existing short links can be edited after they are created.

claims.quote: Each short link may have custom notes attached to it.

claims.quote: The UI features filtering for links, based on short link, long link, and notes.

claims.quote: Options are available for tuning the database to the user's liking.

claims.statement: The UI renders and remains usable when accessed from a mobile device.
claims.tier_basis: If the claim were false, nothing in the buyer's plan changes: the web interface is used only by the buyer's operations engineers, whose use of it is desktop work, and the interface's appearance and rendering are matters the buyer said it does not use. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: If you intend to have more than a few thousand short links, it's strongly recommended that you use the UID [`CHHOTO_SLUG_STYLE`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_style) with a [`CHHOTO_SLUG_LENGTH`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_length) of 16 or more. Otherwise, generating new links will start to fail after a while.
claims.statement: When the target holds more than a few thousand short links under the default slug settings, attempts to generate new short links begin to fail.
claims.tier_basis: If the claim were false, link generation would not begin to fail after a few thousand links, so the buyer loses nothing; a deployer might set a longer slug length than needed, which is harmless, and no stated threshold reaches documentation that understates a limitation. Rated on the scale alone.
